note: Stage 4 (docs/crawling-plan.md §3). This is an ADVISORY review-candidate list, not an auto-exclusion filter — spot-checking the initial version turned up hard false positives (a Personal Income Tax Law decree tagged solely 'Lao động - Thương binh và Xã hội'; a VAT enforcement directive tagged 'Công an' alongside 'Tài chính'), proving vbpl.vn's own major/field tags are too noisy to delete documents on unattended. 'Lao động - Thương binh và Xã hội' was removed entirely after that finding. A document is only flagged when ALL of its majors/fields are on this list (see field_filter.classify) — one on-topic major among several is enough to keep it. Deliberately conservative beyond that too: ambiguous economic-adjacent majors (Giao thông Vận tải, Nông nghiệp, Xây dựng, Khoa học và công nghệ, Tài nguyên và Môi trường) are left OUT on purpose. 'Chưa phân loại' / empty is never treated as foreign (56% of the corpus has no classification at all). Human review of scripts/filter_by_field.py's output is required before excluding anything from Stage 5/6 — see docs/crawling-plan.md §3b's own precedent of not trusting unverified heuristics.
